annotations.title: Change a LinkedIn campaign’s targeting or political declaration

description: Change an existing LinkedIn campaign’s targeting (sent whole), its political-advertising declaration, and/or its name. EU locations need the advertiser’s own declaration: ask, show LinkedIn’s wording (“I confirm this is not political advertising.”), pass politicalIntent only on their answer. Targeting on a LIVE campaign needs confirm:true. Read back from LinkedIn.

confirm.description: true to retarget a LIVE campaign

locations.description: geo URNs or ids, the new audience
